# vendor/

Vendor-provided SDKs and documents only. Never auto-downloaded, never contains credentials.
SDK binaries/headers/archives are git-ignored (see `.gitignore`); documents below were supplied by the project owner.

- `relay/docs/SoyalRelay_address_M-7000_address_mapping_table.pdf` — "M-7000 Series Address Mapping Table" V1.18, Sept 2025 (DIO: pp.70–71).
  Generic table, **not** proof of the installed controller model.
- `access/docs/Soyal_replay_usermanual_721_727H Protocol_EN_2019.pdf` — SOYAL AR-721H/721HV3/727HV3 protocol, 2019-11-05.
  Frame format pp.4–6, relay control p.21. Not an M-7000 Modbus register table.
- `hikvision/` — see `hikvision/README.md`.
- `hvac/`, `nvr/`: empty until the vendor documents arrive.
